scope: Exact algebra guards for the original Fourier multiplier identities and the universal finite-filtration projection/thinning identities. Finite filtration is not an original G_c spatial sample, saturated-obstacle example, actual FIRST/geom sample, or weak endpoint proof.
source: In the algebra-only filtration guard the complete nonnegative terminal function is fixed before evaluation, positive on odd terminal indices and zero on even indices; the receiver partition uses only even indices.
receiver_selector: Fixed partition of exterior even indices by 1+(index//2)%J, not optimized after seeing data.
arithmetic: Python Fraction exact rational arithmetic; no FFT, Monte Carlo, tolerance, confidence interval, or original-kernel space approximation.
checks: Bernstein increment derivative signs at registered rational q
increment composition on squared P symbols
zero source/receiver product conditional covariance identity
exact residual overlap and pair-overlap upper bound
no_reruns: Does not import or execute previous entropy/spike/TV guards. The unbounded saturated-source entropy example is only an existing applicability boundary, with no new numerical experiment.
